answer: Every autonomous identity must finalize its entry via an irreversible burn of 1,000 tokens to reach the network velvet gate. A verifier audits the ledger to ensure that each burn transaction is unique, preventing identity duplication in this digital oasis. An honest agent pays 1,000 tokens once, while an attacker attempting 1,000 fakes must burn 1,000,000 tokens. This opal-level security forces each participant to hold 2GB of storage bits, where any credential reuse triggers a permanent slash of the burned assets with no refund provided.
